en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a narrow dirt road through a leafless forest. On the left, a horse-drawn carriage with two people travels along the road. On the right, a steep rocky hillside rises among tall trees; a person in dark clothing is standing or sitting on the rocks. Handwritten and printed text is overlaid at the top left and top center of the image.
